# statements in command_devices() were read line by line:
#
#     print("== %s ==" % device)
#     print("%-9s: %s" % (k, v))
#     print("%-9s: %s -%s" % ("driver", pkg, info_str))
#
# and info_str is built in this order: " distro" or " third-party", then
# " free" or " non-free", then " builtin" if set, then " recommended" if set.
# The nine-character left-padding of the key is why the colons line up.
#
# That is stronger than guessing at a format and weaker than a recording, and
# the difference matters if ubuntu-drivers ever changes those lines.
#
# THE `builtin` LINE IS THE POINT OF THIS FIXTURE. xserver-xorg-video-nouveau
# is already in the kernel. A device manager that offered it as a fix would be
# telling an operator to install what the machine has.
